entries.description: Although LeNet achieved good results on early small datasets
entries.subject: Although LeNet
entries.object: good results on early small datasets

spans.text: Although LeNet achieved good results on early small datasets, the performance and feasibility of training CNNs on larger, more realistic datasets had yet to be established.

entries.task_id: neural networks|were|often surpassed by other machine learning methods
entries.description: neural networks were often surpassed by other machine learning methods
entries.subject: neural networks
entries.object: often surpassed by other machine learning methods

spans.text: In fact, for much of the intervening time between the early 1990s and the watershed results of 2012 :cite:`Krizhevsky.Sutskever.Hinton.2012`, neural networks were often surpassed by other machine learning methods, such as kernel methods :cite:`Scholkopf.Smola.2002`, ensemble methods :cite:`Freund.Schapire.ea.1996`, and structured estimation :cite:`Taskar.Guestrin.Koller.2004`.
Rather than *learning* the features, the features were *crafted*.

entries.description: network accelerators were available in the 1990s
entries.subject: network accelerators

spans.text: Although some neural network accelerators were available in the 1990s, they were not yet sufficiently powerful to make deep multichannel, multilayer CNNs with a large number of parameters.

entries.description: datasets were still relatively small: OCR on 60
entries.subject: datasets

spans.text: Moreover, datasets were still relatively small: OCR on 60,000 low-resolution $28 \times 28$ pixel images was considered a highly challenging task.
